answer: Every agent posts a 50 POA bond and a referral link, putting the trust graph under a lantern. Karst hides caves, and a referral graph hides the same shape: one sponsor vouching for 100 accounts shows a star any peer may dispute. If the dispute proves one operator, sponsor and linked bonds are slashed, so buying accounts costs 100 x 50 POA. A comet crosses once; a dispute can be filed any epoch. One honest agent posts one bond, keeps its reward.
